fields.title: Date
fields.name: date
fields.description: The date the invoice was officially issued or created.
fields.guidelines:
Target Keywords: "Date", "Date de facture", "Facturé le", "Invoice date", "Date of issue".
Exclusion: Do NOT extract the payment deadline ("Échéance", "Due date"). If there are multiple dates, this is usually the earlier date, often located at the top of the document near the Invoice Number.

fields.title: Period
fields.name: period
fields.description: The date or timeframe that the invoiced services cover.
fields.guidelines:
Target Keywords: "Période", "Prestations du", "Mois de", "Billing period".
Exclusion: This refers to when the work was done, NOT when the invoice was created and NOT when the payment is due. It is often written as a month (e.g., "Juin 2026") or a date range.

fields.title: Due Date
fields.name: due_date
fields.description: The deadline date by which the client must pay the total invoice amount.
fields.guidelines:
Target Keywords (FR): Look specifically for "Échéance", "Date d'échéance", "À payer avant le", "Payable au", "Date limite de paiement", or "Valable jusqu'au".
Target Keywords (EN): Look for "Due date", "Payment due", "Payable by", or "Deadline".
Exclusion: Do NOT extract the invoice issue date ("Date de facture") or the service period ("Période").
Logical Rule: The due date is almost always equal to or later than the invoice issue date. If you see two dates, the later date is typically the due date.
